name: Boon of the Bright Sun

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: As a Bonus Action you shine with sunlight in a 30-foot Emanation that burns away magical Darkness, and you and your allies in it gain 10 Temporary Hit Points at the start of each of your turns.

benefits.name: Bright Sun
benefits.summary: Bonus Action: Bright sunlight in a 30-foot Emanation, dispelling magical Darkness; 10 Temporary Hit Points to you and allies in it at the start of your turns.
benefits.text: As a Bonus Action you shed sunlight: Bright Light in a 30-foot Emanation from you. Magical Darkness overlapping it is dispelled. It lasts until you end it (no action needed), you die, or you have the Incapacitated condition. At the start of each of your turns, you and each ally you can see in the light gain 10 Temporary Hit Points.
